fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the Fix change set on test scripts that depend on the host. Code reading found daemonDiskLow reads the repo filesystem's real free space unless RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES is set alongside RHIZA_TEST_NOW, and only a handful of daemon scripts set it, so on a host whose TMPDIR has under 10G free the daemon scripts start nothing. On the Ubuntu VM (sh is dash) every daemon script already passes, and the fake rex scripts that background a daemon already use exec. Two questions went to the arbiter. It decided that the testscript Setup sets RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES to 1 TiB for every script, with low-disk scripts overriding it, and that this change set makes no shell-portability rewrite: the dash half of the intent is treated as already satisfied, and a script's shell changes only if it is shown to fail under dash. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Host-independent test scripts, autonomous plan interview
